# The director's transaction again, linked by `txn_guid:` alone.
#
# No `txn_split_guid:`, so the run picks the side that is not the `account:`
# — the `Expenses:Supplies:USD` split. Both spellings have to reach the same
# split, which is an invariant this path is paired on everywhere else.
#
# What this fixture produces: the same result as giving the split's own guid.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-DIRECTOR-002"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-01
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-01
    due: 2026-03-01
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-DIRECTOR-002"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-10
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Due From Director USD"
    txn_guid: "aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900"
